definition: A protein encoded by the LRRC7 gene and the only member of the leucine-rich repeat (LRR) and PDZ domain (LAP) family selectively expressed in neurons. It acts as a postsynaptic scaffold at glutamatergic synapses, linking cytoskeletal elements with signaling proteins such as the alpha-subunit of Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II.

source.title: Variants in LRRC7 lead to intellectual disability, autism, aggression and abnormal eating behaviors
source.quote: Densin-180, encoded by LRRC7, is the only LAP protein selectively expressed in neurons. Densin-180 is a postsynaptic scaffold at glutamatergic synapses, linking cytoskeletal elements with signalling proteins such as the α-subunit of Ca2+/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II.
